reason.description: Why the job is paused and what the user should check before resuming. Shown in the PWA.

duration_sec.description: Optional soak period. If set, the wait auto-resumes after this many seconds; omit for an indefinite manual hold.

preview.description: Optional context rendered above the reason (e.g. a health verdict, a diff link, the drafted body of a pending write). Free-form.
